sections.text: Introduction

This 
document outlines the major maintenance procedures P1, to be performed every 
16000 operation hours to ensure good operation protection of all components as 
indicated by H16000 in the title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Ezat Mohamed 
Osman El-Bake, reviewed by eng Azmy Soliman, approved by end. Mohamed Abd El-Ghaffar general director of El-Arish 
PS, and certified by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil; EDEPC inspection 
& quality control general director, MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.

The maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety 
 category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear the safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, shoes, gloves ...etc.
Isolate the circuit breaker of the pump motor.
Disconnect electric terminal of the pump motor.

The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and sactior 
 valves.
Be sure pump must be completely drained.
Be sure oil must be completely drained.

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Compressor End 
fig 2 A,B

Remove screw plug 46009 ad 
drain off the oil.

Remove hex - headed screw 
32163 washers 39165 pat-locking nut 32164 and holding spring 32162.

Screw tight fixing tool 
90030 to looking flange 32107 with hex headed screw 90031.

Unlock cap nut 38001 and 
remove oil pump 36000 with C snaper 90240.
Remove locking plate 32114.

Un screw ring nut 32151 
with box spanner 90050, remove fixing tool 90030.

Pull out centrifing 32150 
(using extractor 90070 and extracting bash 90120 if necessary).

Remove hex - headed screw 
76021 and locking edge achers 76022.

Screw on the extractor 
90070 to the inner bearing bush and withdraw bearing 32100.

Don't remove guide bolt 
as it defines the position of the bearing.

If the bearing 32100 has 
to be replaced the pump holder 32161 should be unscrewed from the dismantled 
bearing and be fixed to the new bearing with hex - headed screw 32152 and locking 
plate 32153. Dismantled part have to be kept clean.

Clean carefully the bearing 
champer before inserting the new bearing it is of utmost importance before 
fitting the bearing that the shaft end is: 
- Thoroughly cleaned.
- Coated with suitable coating to prevent sizning 
such as molykote dx or a similar product.

All surplus paste 
must 
be removed in order to prevent a discoloring of the lubricating oil only white 
coloured products must be used

The spare bearings at 
turbine end supplied by us or our service stations have a correct adjusted 
clearence in the radial damping springs 24105 (fig 5)

Assemble in reverse order 
to dismantling as per when assembling insert the bearing 3-1100 by hand as far 
as possible
Fit the centrifuge 34150.

Screw in the ring nut 
34151 by hand as far as possible with the side of the box spanner 90050 press the 
bearing 34100 and cenbrifuge 34150 onto the shaft shoulder

Loosen the ring nut 34151 
with the box spanner 90050 and retighten it by hand (until it sits close to the 
centrifuge)

Slip on the box spanner 
90050 with the engraved mark "O" on the top and apply a mark on the centrifuge in 
the radial elongation of "O" fig. 2

Tighten the ring nut 34151 
by knocking with a hammer on the tommy bar 90260 until the turbocharger size 
engrave on the box spanner 90050 matches with the mark on the centrifuge 34150 
while doing so the box spanner 90050 must be supported by hand.
Please Note: to prevent the shaft 
from distorting the rotor must be turned by 180 
after each stroke using the box spanner and rig nut 32151.

Fit the locking plate 32114 on the shaft and check 
whether it possible to secure in this position if none of the tongues of the 
locking plate 32114 matches with the slats of the ring nut 32151 tighten the 
later a little move until the securing operation can be done blamelessly.

Carefully fit the hex-headed screws 76021 and 
locking washers resp. locking edge washers 76022 and tighten then firmly.

Damaged locking plates or locking washers have to 
be replaced by new ones.

Measure the distance "K" at compressor and check 
whether it agrees with the figures shown on plates 46011 inside the bearing 
space cover 46000.

Check the axial contact surfaces of oil pump 
36000 before flitting it they must be absolutely clean and free of any damage.

Check the true running of the pump,
figure 2B

Lock carefully cap nut 36001 and ring nut 32151 
with the plate 32114, center the pipe of the pump with the spring 32162 in 
holder 32161 the pipe of the pump should not touch the pump holder.

sections.text: Oil Pump

items:
All oil pump must be examined for wear and 
 leakage after they have run for 16000 hours this check and possible 
 repairs are performed by our service station this check should be 
 repeated after each further 16000 hours

After the oil pumps have been fitted the true 
 running must be checked in any case if the turbocharger is equipped with 
 an oil flow monitor consider when sending the oil pump 36000 or 39000 to 
 the service station for overhaul, always join the connecting cable 32205 
 or 34205after fitting the overhauled oil pumps set up the oil flow monitors 32211 or 34211

It's only necessary to check clearances after 
 an overhaul where parts of the turbocharger were replaced
The distance "K"

Clearances L and M fig 14 must be checked 
 after each overhaul
